没有固定方法，按这次需要定: No fixed method; decide by what this one needs
做法按本人的习惯来，不套用模板: The approach follows how they actually work, not a template
平时怎么做这类事？: How do they usually do this kind of work?
先读材料再动手: Read the material first, then start
先动手，遇到问题再查: Start doing it, look things up when stuck
和别人讨论着做: Work it out together with others
遇到要准备的考核、要赶的截止，或者要学一样新东西，你平时是怎么做的？: When you have an assessment to prepare for, a deadline to meet or something new to learn, how do you usually go about it?
